observations.uncertainty: This release states the 25-basis-point change but does not print the absolute before/after levels; those levels remain null.
A dated tightening milestone, not proof that every intervening rate decision is covered or that this level persists after later decisions.
The effective-date year follows the September 2024 announcement. The exact dated release supersedes month-only timing from the economic review.

limitations: The CBUAE Base Rate is anchored to the US Federal Reserve's Interest on Reserve Balances; it is not the federal-funds target range.
The Base Rate is an overnight money-market policy rate, not a retail mortgage quote, EIBOR tenor, lender margin or borrower-specific financing cost.
These selected observations cannot be forward-filled into a complete policy-rate history without enumerating intervening and subsequent decisions.
Rate changes are financing context; no local price response, investment return, migration effect or causal coefficient is inferred.
